# A made-up Facebook export

Every person, message, date and photo here was created for this project. Nothing came from a real Facebook account.

The `facebook` folder is a small JSON export that exercises old dates, already-correct Unicode, a private conversation, a photo-only post and an unknown date. The blue postcard is a 64 × 40 pixel geometric test image generated locally, with no EXIF or embedded location. It is a fixture, not application artwork.

Import the folder through the app's folder chooser, or ZIP its contents and upload that ZIP. A completed import should produce seven records: four posts, one private message, one friend record and one profile. Importing it again should add no records. Only the selected copies of posts/photos can enter the social feed; the message and friend roster stay private.
